About the Business


Deloitte China Clients & Industries is comprised of cross-region, multi-disciplinary teams with key mandates to drive business growth with focus on priority accounts and strategic sectors.

Work you'll do

 

  • Work across businesses to develop FSI industry-specific campaigns, services, solutions and related materials

  • Work across businesses to support HK FSI thought leadership development and eminence building

    • Coordination and other support for thought leadership development, navigate industry network to identify internal/external resources to contribute to thought leadership development

    • External and internal thought leadership marketing including media events, social media release, client promotion, internal Thought Ware communication etc.

  • Support industry/sector leadership to drive sector priority accounts' development and develop other industry key accounts  

  • Liaise with global/AP industry teams to drive cross-PF/MF collaboration

  • Develop sense of community across HK FSI organization through regular communications (HK FSI Digest) and related meetings

  • Assist in HK FSI financial planning and presentations, monitor and coordinate industry expenses budget

  • Prepare monthly performance report for HK FSI and sectors, as well as ad hoc report and analysis requests from relevant stakeholders (e.g. HK Leap, AP One FSI)

  • Internal meeting organization, preparation of meeting papers, support, and attendance for specific industry sectors 

 

During your tenure with us, you will demonstrate and develop your leadership and professional capabilities in the following areas: Inspiring, Creating purpose, Driving agility, Building diverse capability, Influencing, Collaborating, Delivering value, Building the business, Analytical acumen, Effective communication, Engagement management/delivery excellence, Managing change, Managing quality & risk, Strategic thinking and problem solving, and Tech savviness.

We are looking for someone with

 

To be considered for this position, you must demonstrate skills and experience in the following areas:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above, with knowledge and experience in financial services industry 

  • Fluent in written & oral English and Chinese Mandarin

  • Able to work independently and collaborate with team members in Hong Kong and overseas through email, virtual meetings and face-to-face meetings

  • 5-6 years of working experience in Business Consulting and/or Marketing, experience in corporate communication, copywriting, digital marketing and/or project management is preferable

  • Good financial and business acumen 

  • Strong analytical and interpersonal skills, with the ability to demonstrate, to communicate and resolve complex issues

  • Proactive, responsible, and excellent organizational and planning skills. 

  • Technical skills required: MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel.

 

#LI-LC1

Shape your future through impact that matters

 

For more than 100 years of history, Deloitte witnessed also had the honor to be part of the economic boom in China by providing industry-leading audit & assurance, consulting, risk advisory, financial advisory, tax & business advisory services to nearly 90% of the Fortune Global 500 Chinese companies and thousands of private companies. Deloitte China today carries on our centenary professionalism and strives to become the undisputed leader in professional services in China with strong responsibility and capabilities in digitalization and multidisciplinary services.

 

Deloitte has been named China's Top Employer since 2006, Universum's Most Attractive Employer in China since 2008, and the Best Workplaces in Greater China since 2019.

 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of their background, experience, identity, ability or thinking style, and if you need assistance during the application process for accessibility reasons this is available upon request. The preferred candidate will be subject to background screening by Deloitte China or by their external third-party provider.

 

Accessibility assistance


If you need assistance or an accommodation during the recruitment  process for accessibility reasons, there will be an opportunity for you to let us know what you need once you begin your application.

 

Ready to take on new challenges? Apply now!
Stay connected for the latest career opportunities, follow us on Deloitte China Social Media.

About the Business

Our Human Resources professionals drive the firm's people strategy, create a unique people experience, and work with the business to drive success in the marketplace.


Work you'll do

  • Support national and regional function leader to develop and implement people plan and programs in line with the business plan

  • Participate the regular function management meeting, provide HR insight and suggestion for the people decision making

  • Ensure proper execution of HR policy, program and practice according with firm guidelines / policies and local labor regulations

  • Assist the function on headcount & salary cost budgeting, and providing the monthly report to the function leader and group partners

  • Support the effective implementation of performance management and salary review practice in the function 

  • Handle the global and national secondment, internal transfer in order to meet the staffing needs

  • Support the account to set up and maintain the effective internal communication

  • Manage the exit procedures and proposed the follow-up actions based on the exit interviews and the monthly turnover analysis

  • Manage the staff recognition and the staff discipline procedures

  • Support the people activities (e.g. ER events, EAP programs, etc.) in the function to strengthen the employee relationship

  • Suggest, develop and implement the people initiatives specific to the function concerned

  • Work collaboratively with Regional Recruitment and Deloitte Institute to ensure recruitment and learning needs of the functional groups are met

  • Manage and coach  the account team subordinates, and coordinate the cross regions HR  taskforces for projects and processes when necessary

  • Support the national and regional HR community


During your tenure with us, you will demonstrate and develop your leadership and professional capabilities in the following areas: Inspiring, Creating purpose, Driving agility, Building diverse capability, Influencing, Collaborating, Delivering value, Building the business, Analytical acumen, Effective communication, Engagement management/delivery excellence, Managing change, Managing quality & risk, Sales excellence, Strategic thinking and problem solving, and Tech savviness.

We are looking for someone with

  • Bachelor degree or above 

  • Minimum of ten years relevant experience in the sizeable multinational companies, the service firm experiences is desirable

  • Solid HR generalist experience could be reframed as HRBP experience

  • Always take the initiative, self-motivated, flexible and willing to work under pressure

  • Strong project management skills, a good team leader and player

  • Excellent written and oral English and Mandarin


About Deloitte China

Deloitte China provides integrated professional services, with our long-term commitment to be a leading contributor to China’s reform, opening-up and economic development. We are a globally connected firm with deep roots locally, owned by our partners in China. With over 20,000 professionals across 31 Chinese cities, we provide our clients with a one-stop shop offering world-leading audit, tax and consulting services.

 

We provide comprehensive, end-to-end, and integrated services to address clients’ core issues, empowering them with our multidisciplinary service model. Deloitte is an undisputed leader in professional services in China with strong responsibility and capabilities in digitalization and multidisciplinary services.

 

Deloitte China has been honored as 'China Top Employers 2026' for the 20th consecutive year.

 

Shaping future talent through impact that matters

Throughout over 180 years of development, Deloitte is committed to making an impact that matters to clients, people, and society. Deloitte China practices “4+1” culture – Courage, Innovation, Inclusion, Wellbeing, + Integrity, which is rooted in our service purpose and lays the foundation for sustainable growth and prosperity. Deloitte is a people-oriented professional services firm,  empowering every Deloitter to unlock their intrinsic motivation and limitless potential. We are committed to cultivating high-caliber and diversified talent, providing continuous momentum for the development of the firm and China.

 

Deloitte China has established clear career development paths, covering different industries, professional areas, and levels. Through six mechanisms of DU AP China Project, global mobility, counseling system, learning platform, project engagement, and innovation incentives, we provide all-around support on upskilling and career development for our people to upgrade professional service capabilities, enhance innovative thinking and pursue the career success.

 

A world of opportunities awaits. Start your adventure and journey with us

 

Accessibility assistance

If you need assistance or an accommodation during the recruitment  process for accessibility reasons, there will be an opportunity for you to let us know what you need once you begin your application.

 

Ready to take on new challenges? Apply now!

Stay connected for the latest career opportunities, follow us on Deloitte China Social Media.
